scope: calibration only; revised input-consistency guard; no application/profile/model/configuration changes
candidate_definition: Execute the exact frozen application helper source in memory in the existing Spark container. The helper preserves sufficient and inconsistent baseline evidence; discards original blocks below1.5s or failing existing sample-quality checks; checks purpose minimum eligible PCM seconds before embedding; requires all original guard pair cosines>=0.55, uses unchanged reference extract_evidence for packed3–8s windows, then every guard-to-packed and existing partial-anchor cosine>=0.55. Runtime itself is unchanged. This exact helper snapshot replaces the independently written diagnostic implementation before any scoring of this candidate.
compatibility: Both candidate-query to original baseline40profile gallery and baseline-query to candidate gallery, all planned denominators plus baseline-covered people.
wrong_person_append: For each pair(A,B), use full B enrollment audio as a hypothetical append into existing baseline profile A. Apply candidate enrollment-quality rules and the existing recognized/top-target guard against the fixed40profile baseline gallery; no database writes.
mixed_alternating: For each pair(A,B), alternate disjoint2second chunks from the first16seconds of each enrollment waveform: A0:2,B0:2,...,A14:16,B14:16, yielding32seconds. No repeated samples or added silence. Run baseline and both candidates with enrollment purpose; report quality acceptance and baseline-gallery decision separately. Passing a mixed clip is not counted as a successful negative test.
mixed_gapped: First8seconds per original speaker, alternating disjoint2s blocks for4cycles with0.4s inserted silence between blocks:18.8seconds. Silence is negative-fixture input only; not added by the algorithm or counted as eligible speech.
negative_verdict: Any mixed enrollment passing quality is a failed negative; report both absolute failures and new failures vs baseline. Existing baseline successes are intentionally preserved.
held_out_policy: Never load test.json or held-out audio/results during selection. All scores are calibration diagnostics, not new live application evidence.
negative_pair_selection: First20 baseline-usable calibration gallery speakers, paired in fixed gallery order before candidate scoring; no identities included here.
